sections.name: Benchmark report hero
sections.description: The annual report opener: gradient-accented report title, mono n= sample line, get-the-report CTA pair, and one finding pulled forward as a report-cover card with a mono edition tag and a pdf format stamp. Ties straight into the gated-content recipe.

props.name: titleAccent
props.doc: substring of title rendered in the brand gradient; the section's one gradient element

props.name: sampleLine
props.doc: the mono n= sample-size line under the sub

props.name: reportTag
props.doc: mono edition tag in the cover card header

props.name: statEyebrow
props.doc: mono finding number opposite the edition tag

props.name: statValue
props.doc: the one stat pulled forward, display-face numeral

props.name: formatLine
props.doc: mono format stamp in the cover card footer (pages, gate)

sections.name: Benchmarks-by-stage table
sections.description: Metric medians cut by company stage: token-built table (the bundle Table's props don't carry row highlighting or per-cell mono) with mono caps column headers, mono values, ONE accent-soft highlighted row tagged as the metric Alfred moves, and a mono methodology stamp printed under the data like a plate mark.

props.name: metricHeader
props.doc: header of the metric column

props.name: stages
props.doc: value column headers, e.g. Seed / Growth / Scale

props.name: rows
props.doc: one row per metric; at most one row carries highlight: true

props.name: highlightTag
props.doc: mono bracket tag shown on the highlighted row

props.name: stamp
props.doc: the mono methodology stamp under the table

sections.name: Percentile band
sections.description: Where you rank: a horizontal distribution bar with quartile ticks, a periwinkle interquartile band, and ONE accent marker (phosphor-glow, the you-after-90-days flag) near the good end of the axis. Mono axis endpoints and a caption row with the band legend and the n= count.

props.name: axisStart
props.doc: mono label at the start of the axis

props.name: axisEnd
props.doc: mono label at the end of the axis

props.name: ticks
props.doc: quartile ticks; pos is 0-100 along the axis, first and last also bound the shaded band

props.name: marker
props.doc: the one accent marker; keep pos low enough that the flag fits inside the card

props.name: bandLabel
props.doc: legend text for the interquartile band

props.name: captionStart
props.doc: mono axis caption (units, direction of good)

props.name: captionEnd
props.doc: mono sample stamp at the end of the caption row

sections.name: Methodology note
sections.description: The fine print as a first-class block and a credibility device: sample, period, definitions and limits in a quiet two-column note on a sunken band, each entry under a numbered mono sidenote, with a mono dataset-available footnote under the closing hairline.

props.name: intro
props.doc: one-line stance on why the fine print is shown

props.name: items
props.doc: the note entries; sidenote renders in numbered mono caps

props.name: footnote
props.doc: mono closing line under the bottom hairline
